What it does

Smith.ai exists to solve one expensive problem: the phone ringing while you are under a house or on a roof. An AI receptionist answers, qualifies the enquiry and books the work, escalating to a live agent when the conversation needs judgement. Per-call pricing is unpredictable in busy months, but so is the cost of a missed job.

Where the AI actually is

AI answers and qualifies enquiries, escalating to a live agent when needed.

Pros

  • Stops missed calls becoming lost jobs
  • Answers outside working hours
  • Human fallback when the AI is unsure

Cons

  • Per-call pricing is unpredictable in busy months

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Roofers, Remodelers & carpenters in mind. Trades that lose jobs because nobody can answer the phone on site.
